title: Fox that Says Things
description: You will hear the sound of Bård Ylvisåker in every taiga biome.
body:
All fox sounds are now sounds from the song "What does the fox say" by Ylvis.
For example, the ambient noise of foxes is now Bård Ylvisåker saying "Ring-ding-ding-ding-dingeringeding! Gering-ding-ding-ding-dingeringeding! Gering-ding-ding-ding-dingeringeding!" at varying pitches. It is a little loud compared to the rest of the game sounds. 

If you find any bugs, have improvement suggestions, or want to communicate with me about something, please join the Discord server.
